items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: well, maybe Whiteman had been in a film.

ctx.x: us. Going to Hollywood to make a picture, a movie with Amos and Andy. That was very big for us.
Well, I mean, actually, I don't think any jazz bands -- well, maybe Whiteman had been in a film. But I don't think any other jazz bands had been, had they?
I don't know. I don't think so.
